title: On the Menu: Buuz, Khuushuur, and Attributive Descriptors
primaryPurpose: Introduce traditional Mongolian restaurant food items (бууз, хуушуур, цуйван, банштай шөл) and attributive adjective placement directly preceding nouns (халуун шөл, амттай хоол, шинэ мах).
communicativeOutcome: Identify traditional dishes on a menu and describe food items using attributive adjectives without case inflection.
readingObjective: Read printed laminated cafeteria and restaurant menus displaying staple Mongolian dishes.
listeningObjective: Hear restaurant waiters reciting daily specials with descriptive adjectives.
writingObjective: Write 4 noun phrases combining taste/temperature adjectives with food items (e.g. 'халуун ногоотой цуйван').
spokenProductionObjective: Name 3 favorite traditional Mongolian dishes and describe their flavor aloud.
pragmaticTarget: Accurate culinary identification when ordering in local eateries.
reviewReason: Combine portion counts (нэг аяга, гурван ширхэг) with food nouns.
audioPurpose: Clear pronunciation of initial consonant combinations in dish names (хуушуур, цуйван).
successCriteria: Place attributive adjectives directly before modified nouns without changing form.
Distinguish buuz (steamed dumplings) from khuushuur (fried meat pasties) on menu.
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би халуун шөл уумаар байна' accurately.
Reads 5 menu items fluently and identifies their meat ingredients.

title: At the Counter: Ordering Portions with 'Авъя' and 'Өгөөч'
primaryPurpose: Introduce standard ordering formulas at fast-casual canteens (цайны газар): 'Би ... авъя' (I'll take...) and '... өгөөч' (please give me...).

listeningObjective: Comprehend canteen servers taking customer orders and clarifying piece counts.
writingObjective: Draft a short 3-item order slip specifying food name, count, and drink.
spokenProductionObjective: Place an order for 5 khuushuur and a hot milk tea at a simulated food counter.
pragmaticTarget: Direct, polite counter transactions typical of Mongolian food culture.
reviewReason: Mark accusative objects when specifying definite meals to the server.
audioPurpose: Natural counter service cadence and polite request intonation.
successCriteria: Formulate orders using '... авъя' or '... өгөөч' without hesitation.
Specify piece counts using 'ширхэг' (e.g. 'Таван ширхэг хуушуур авъя').
masteryEvidence: Executes a complete 4-turn food ordering dialogue at a counter.
Correctly specifies half-portions ('хагас порц') where applicable.

title: Doing Things Together: The Comitative Case -тай/-тэй/-той

reviewReason: Combine comitative companions with witnessed past action verbs.

successCriteria: Select -тай for back unrounded stems, -тэй for front stems, -той for back rounded stems.

masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би нэг эгчтэй, хоёр дүүтэй' smoothly.
Differentiates possession (-тай байна) from location (-д байна).

title: Chaining Actions in Time: The Sequential Converb -аад/-ээд/-оод/-өөд
primaryPurpose: Introduce the sequential converb suffix -аад/-ээд/-оод/-өөд denoting completed anterior action ('having done X, then Y') and four-way vowel harmony rules.
communicativeOutcome: Connect two chronologically ordered actions into a single coherent clause (e.g. 'Би цай уугаад гарсан' - Having drank tea, I went out).
readingObjective: Read sequenced daily routines and dining narratives using -аад/-ээд.

spokenProductionObjective: State two sequential actions performed this morning using -аад aloud.
pragmaticTarget: Clear chronological clause linking without repetitive clunky coordinate structures.
reviewReason: Contrast simultaneous/manner coordination (-ж/-ч) with chronological succession (-аад).
audioPurpose: Natural narrative rhythm connecting two sequential verbal clauses.
successCriteria: Select -аад for /a/, -ээд for /e, i/, -оод for /o/, -өөд for /ö/ stems.
Ensure anterior action precedes the main inflected matrix verb.
masteryEvidence: Conjugates идэх -> идээд, уух -> уугаад, орох -> ороод, үзэх -> үзээд accurately.
Combines two simple sentences into one coherent sequential sentence.
